{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for invalid revenue values (e.g., 999999.99) — per documentation, six internal QA orders with this value exist
df_qa = df[df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print("Number of QA rows with revenue 999999.99:", len(df_qa))

# Check if any QA rows are in the LOYAL + completed group
loyal_completed_qa = df_qa[(df_qa['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (df_qa['status'] == 'completed')]
print("QA rows in LOYAL + completed group:", len(loyal_completed_qa))"}
